# Bonooru conformance vectors (AD-14). Format: vectors/README.md.
# Generated by an independent implementation and reviewed by hand;
# a wire change edits these files first.
#
# messages.txt: type, seq, fields, body, wire (COBS, no delimiter), optional trailing
# (bytes after the v1 body that decode ignores); or type, body, err (BODY_LEN).
# fields: numbers as big-endian hex of their full width, arrays and state in wire order.
proto_version: 01

# HELLO, seq 00: crc16("01 00 01 01") = d164, sent as 64 d1
hello.type: 01
hello.seq: 00
hello.fields: proto_ver=01
hello.body: 01
hello.wire: 02 01 05 01 01 64 d1

# HELLO from a newer app with two trailing bytes: accepted, rest ignored (D10)
hello_trailing.type: 01
hello_trailing.seq: 09
hello_trailing.fields: proto_ver=02
hello_trailing.body: 02 aa bb
hello_trailing.trailing: aa bb
hello_trailing.wire: 09 01 09 03 02 aa bb 75 f2

# INFO: fw 0.2.3, bridge 0.2.1, P2, queue 512, app timeout 1000 ms, report period 8000 us
info.type: 81
info.seq: 00
info.fields: proto_ver=01 fw_ver=000203 bridge_ver=000201 hid_profile=02 queue_cap=0200 app_timeout_ms=03e8 report_period_us=1f40
info.body: 01 00 02 03 00 02 01 02 00 02 e8 03 40 1f
info.wire: 02 81 03 0e 01 03 02 03 04 02 01 02 08 02 e8 03 40 1f e6 c0

# INFO with queue_cap, app_timeout_ms and report_period_us at ffff
info_max.type: 81
info_max.seq: 01
info_max.fields: proto_ver=01 fw_ver=ffffff bridge_ver=000000 hid_profile=03 queue_cap=ffff app_timeout_ms=ffff report_period_us=ffff
info_max.body: 01 ff ff ff 00 00 00 03 ff ff ff ff ff ff
info_max.wire: 08 81 01 0e 01 ff ff ff 01 01 0a 03 ff ff ff ff ff ff 37 db

# INFO with one trailing byte: accepted (D10)
info_trailing.type: 81
info_trailing.seq: 02
info_trailing.fields: proto_ver=01 fw_ver=010000 bridge_ver=010000 hid_profile=01 queue_cap=0010 app_timeout_ms=0000 report_period_us=0000
info_trailing.body: 01 01 00 00 01 00 00 01 10 00 00 00 00 00 5a
info_trailing.trailing: 5a
info_trailing.wire: 06 81 02 0f 01 01 01 02 01 01 03 01 10 01 01 01 01 04 5a 98 8c

# SET_STATE NEUTRAL

# SET_STATE: A and + pressed, hat right, left stick up, right stick right
set_state_a_plus.type: 02

set_state_a_plus.body: 04 02 02 80 00 ff 80 00
set_state_a_plus.wire: 08 02 02 08 04 02 02 80 03 ff 80 03 2c 91

# QUEUE_EVENT, seq 02, t_us = 1000 us, NEUTRAL (t_us little-endian: e8 03 00 00)
queue_event_neutral.type: 03
queue_event_neutral.seq: 02
queue_event_neutral.fields: t_us=000003e8 state=0000088080808000
queue_event_neutral.body: e8 03 00 00 00 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
queue_event_neutral.wire: 06 03 02 0c e8 03 01 01 01 06 08 80 80 80 80 03 a8 fd

# QUEUE_EVENT with t_us = 01020304: the body starts 04 03 02 01
queue_event_le_order.type: 03
queue_event_le_order.seq: 03
queue_event_le_order.fields: t_us=01020304 state=0100008080808000
queue_event_le_order.body: 04 03 02 01 01 00 00 80 80 80 80 00
queue_event_le_order.wire: 09 03 03 0c 04 03 02 01 01 01 05 80 80 80 80 03 cc f6

# QUEUE_EVENT NEUTRAL|END, the last event of a piece (AD-8)
queue_event_end.type: 03
queue_event_end.seq: 04
queue_event_end.fields: t_us=7fffffff state=0000088080808001
queue_event_end.body: ff ff ff 7f 00 00 08 80 80 80 80 01
queue_event_end.wire: 08 03 04 0c ff ff ff 7f 01 09 08 80 80 80 80 01 8f 46

# STATUS base (11 bytes): free 500, now_us 0x123456, last_seq 41, PLAYING, 3 aborts, last PLAYBACK_DONE, link_ok|console_ready
status_base.type: 83
status_base.seq: 07
status_base.fields: free=01f4 now_us=00123456 last_seq=41 mode=02 abort_count=03 last_event=01 flags=03
status_base.body: f4 01 56 34 12 00 41 02 03 01 03
status_base.wire: 09 83 07 0b f4 01 56 34 12 08 41 02 03 01 03 67 ef

# STATUS with 3 trailing debug-counter bytes exposed as extra
status_extra.type: 83
status_extra.seq: 08
status_extra.fields: free=0000 now_us=00000000 last_seq=ff mode=00 abort_count=ff last_event=05 flags=01 extra=102030
status_extra.body: 00 00 00 00 00 00 ff 00 ff 05 01 10 20 30
status_extra.wire: 04 83 08 0e 01 01 01 01 01 02 ff 08 ff 05 01 10 20 30 ac 01

# ACK seq 2a
ack.type: 84

ack.body: 2a

# NAK SEQ: expected 05, got 07
nak_seq.type: 85

nak_seq.fields: reason=02 expected=05 got=07
nak_seq.body: 02 05 07
nak_seq.wire: 09 85 0a 03 02 05 07 31 a5

# NAK with an unknown reason 7e: decodes as a plain byte (AD-19)

nak_unknown_reason.fields: reason=7e expected=00 got=ff
nak_unknown_reason.body: 7e 00 ff
nak_unknown_reason.wire: 05 85 0b 03 7e 04 ff eb 33
